in_sanskrit.name: Argha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Offering, Dedication
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Argha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Argha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अर्घ’ (Argha) which means 'an offering' or 'a dedication'. This name is associated with the act of giving and is often used for those who are devoted to their beliefs or are generous in nature.
